answer: Let trust be earned in throughput, not bought. Every new identity starts with a tiny quota: few transactions, small amounts, narrow reach. Quotas grow only with verified, completed work over time, the way a ridge path widens only where real feet pass. An honest newcomer feels a brief headwind, then a clear road; a sybil operator faces a gale that never drops, because each of a thousand fakes must be aged through months of genuine, rate-limited activity before it can move anything that matters. Time multiplied by headcount cannot be parallelized away, and umber patience is what farms lack.
